quests.title: Poirot - Make a Missing Ed Flyer
quests.prereqText: Have completed 2nd Job Advancement (Level 60+)
steps: Talk to Poirot at Gate of Caballa Relics: he gives you Brother's Pendant.
Get 1x Enlarged Brother's Picture: reward from Wandering Photographer Ren - Flyer Picture Request (2).
Bring everything back to Poirot.

source.from: Reward from Wandering Photographer Ren - Flyer Picture Request (2)

quests.notes: Brother's Pendant is obtained with Poirot when the quest starts. Enlarged Brother's Picture is obtained by completing Wandering Photographer Ren - Flyer Picture Request (2).

quests.title: Wandering Photographer Ren - Flyer Picture Request (1)
quests.prereqText: Have Poirot - Make a Missing Ed Flyer in quest log
steps: Talk to Wandering Photographer Ren at Gate of Caballa Relics.

Get 1x Gold Lens: compound 1x Optical Glass Crystal + 1x Animal Bone + 5x Gold with Compounder Paul in Relics Town - Azteca (Optical Glass Crystal and Animal Bone are drilled in Caballa Relics Fields).
Bring everything back to Wandering Photographer Ren.

source.from: Compounder Paul: 1x Optical Glass Crystal + 1x Animal Bone + 5x Gold

quests.notes: Gold Lens is obtained by compounding 1x Optical Glass Crystal + 1x Animal Bone + 5x Gold with Compounder Paul in Relics Town - Azteca. Optical Glass Crystal and Animal Bone are drilled in Caballa Relics Fields. The wiki gives no quantity for Gold Lens.

quests.title: Wandering Photographer Ren - Flyer Picture Request (2)
quests.prereqText: Have completed Wandering Photographer Ren - Flyer Picture Request (1)
steps: Talk to Wandering Photographer Ren at Gate of Caballa Relics.

quests.notes: Expensive Film is drilled in Caballa Relics Fields.
